theme: Travel day — the long way home from Croatia.
greeting: You're flying home today, Dan: Dubrovnik to Frankfurt to Tampa, wheels down at 3:55. The trip's behind you and Florida is ahead — a quiet couple of days before the kids come Tuesday.

needsAttention.title: Rental car waiting when you land
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV rental starts today and you touch down at TPA at 3:55 PM. It's no longer a hedge — the note to self is to not arrive jet-lagged on a Sunday to walk-up rates.

needsAttention.title: Somewhere to land tonight
needsAttention.detail: You're back in Tampa this afternoon but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday — the nights of the 20th and 21st in the St. Pete area are still the open gap before the Orlando villa.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV, before it sells out
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market, and the Pathfinder is south by then. A refundable hold now costs nothing; waiting genuinely costs money.

schedule.detail: The long leg home, landing 3:55 PM

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and digests — NYT Cooking, the WSJ tech roundup, a few St. Pete locals, and Dex keep-in-touch reminders.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

recipe.title: Ginger spice cake with dried cherries
recipe.why: A warming autumn bake for the season's first cool afternoons, when dried fruit and warm spice feel right.

tasks.title: Plan a grocery stop before the Orlando villa

acts.line: You're in the air before dawn — the short hop Dubrovnik to Frankfurt, then the long leg toward home.
Wheels down at Tampa at 3:55, back on Florida ground after two weeks in Croatia.
First night stateside is yours — the kids arrive Tuesday, so tonight is for resetting the clock.
